$comment: antd -> lucide icon mapping (to-astryx ticket 07). Covers 100% of the @ant-design/icons names actually imported in react/src + packages/backend.ai-ui/src (measured 2026-08-07 in this worktree: 227 files, 97 distinct glyph names + Icon + CustomIconComponentProps). Consumed by scripts/codemods/antd-icons-to-lucide.mjs. 'lucide' = export name verified against lucide-react@1.28.0. 'astryxRegistry' = Astryx semantic Icon registry name that matches — prefer the registry string when the icon lands inside an Astryx component (icon prop), pass the lucide component otherwise (MAPPING.md section 7). 'ownSvg' entries have no lucide equivalent and map to a repo-owned SVG asset instead. Lucide is stroke-only: every antd Filled/TwoTone variant collapses onto its Outlined twin's glyph and the distinction moves to the label (PILOT-DECISION, simplicity policy).

shim.$comment: Not glyphs: @ant-design/icons' default export `Icon` is a real component (P16). Both names re-route to the repo-owned shim, same import shapes.

DeleteFilled.note: PILOT-DECISION: antd pairs DeleteFilled ('delete forever') with DeleteOutlined ('move to trash'). Stroke-only lucide keeps the pair distinguishable as Trash2 (lined bin) vs Trash (plain bin), but the forever/trash semantics now rest primarily on the label/confirm copy. 33-file-wide decision flagged in MAPPING.md section 7.

ReloadOutlined.note: Single circular arrow, matching the antd glyph. SyncOutlined (two arrows) takes RefreshCw.

SettingOutlined.note: Astryx registry resolves 'wrench' for settings/config; neutral theme currently renders it with lucide Wrench, but Settings (gear) is the closer antd match for direct use.

LoadingOutlined.note: antd call sites pass `spin`; lucide has no spin prop. Codemod rewrites `spin` to className="bai-icon-spin" (keyframes live in packages/backend.ai-ui/src/styles/backend.ai-ui.css). Inside Astryx components prefer the native loading state instead.

ExclamationCircleFilled.note: Filled collapses onto the outlined glyph.

CheckCircleFilled.note: Filled collapses onto the outlined glyph.

SyncOutlined.note: Two-arrow cycle, matching the antd glyph.

WarningTwoTone.note: PILOT-DECISION: TwoTone color rendering is inexpressible in stroke-only lucide; twoToneColor prop is dropped (codemod flags it). Semantic color should come from the surrounding component/token.

EditOutlined.note: Repo already standardized on SquarePen(Icon) for edit affordances (36 existing lucide imports).

QuestionCircleFilled.note: Filled collapses onto the outlined glyph.

CloseCircleFilled.note: Filled collapses onto the outlined glyph.

CaretDownOutlined.note: PILOT-DECISION: filled caret glyph is inexpressible in stroke-only lucide; chevron replaces it (defaults-first policy).

GithubOutlined.note: lucide-react 1.x removed brand icons (Github/Gitlab existed only in 0.x). Own SVG carries the antd glyph geometry (@ant-design/icons-svg, MIT).

SecurityScanOutlined.note: PILOT-DECISION: antd's shield+magnifier composite has no lucide twin; plain shield-check per simplicity policy.

PlayCircleFilled.note: Filled collapses onto the outlined glyph.

StopFilled.note: antd Stop is a prohibition sign -> Ban. Astryx registry 'stop' is media-stop (Square) — different semantics, do not use the registry name here.
